chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Ri'ab, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, this anger is an ember from Satan that is kindled in the heart of the son of Adam. And when one of you becomes angry, his eyes turn red, his veins puff up, and Satan enters him. So when one of you fears that from himself, let him press himself to the earth, for the filth of Satan will depart from him at that time.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical nature of anger in Shia hadith, and how can it be neutralized?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Baqir (AS) characterizes anger as a spiritual ember ignited by Satan, manifesting physically through red eyes and swollen veins. He prescribes the practical remedy of sitting or lying on the ground, a method rooted in the belief that lowering the body disrupts the devil's influence and facilitates its departure. This teaching underscores the Shia emphasis on combining physical discipline with spiritual awareness to neutralize the internal effects of wrath.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ib Raib, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘This anger is an ember from the Satan<sup>la</sup>, being inflamed in the head of the son of Adam<sup>as</sup>, and that one of you, when he gets angered, his eyes turn red, his veins puff up and Satan<sup>la</sup> enters in him. So when one of you fears that from himself, so let him hold on to the earth, for the filth of the Satan<sup>la</sup> would go away from him during that’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father all from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from abu Hamza al-Thumali from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “

This anger is a spark from Satan that he lights up in the hearts of the children of Adam. Whenever any of you becomes angry, his eyes turn red, his veins puff up and Satan enters into it. If any of you fears this, he must hold to the earth; in so doing the evil of Satan goes away.”
